entities.title: Online game messages
entities.summary: What a Shatterbelt page sends the other pages of a match through the games hub's relay.
consumers: The other Shatterbelt pages in the same match
The games hub's relay, which passes messages on in order
guarantees: start: { slots, seed, delay, mode, ticket }, sent by the host; ticket is the server's { id, seed } or null
in: { f, b }, the sender's controls (the engine's control bits) from step f on
sum: { f, h }, a fingerprint of step f: the generator's state, time, wave, counts of rocks, shots and drones, and every ship's position, angle, score and lives
rtt: { ms }, the sender's round trip, when it changes by 5 ms or more
name: { player, name }, after the game, the sender's own pilot's name or null
results: { results }, from the host after submitting: the server's results, or null when nothing was submitted
entities.compatibility: start, in, sum and rtt come from src/online.ts, the same file in Rally and Hivestorm, and change with its copies there. start's mode and ticket, name and results are Shatterbelt's own; every page of a match runs the same deployed version.

entities.title: The address the multiplayer page opens
entities.summary: /games/retro/shatterbelt/?match=ID&mode=coop or versus, for every pilot of a match.
consumers: The games hub's multiplayer page, which offers Shatterbelt co-op and Shatterbelt versus
guarantees: match is the relay's match ID; the page joins it on load
mode=versus plays versus; anything else plays co-op

entities.title: This device's table
entities.summary: localStorage shatterbelt.scores.v1: the best ten scores kept in this browser.
guarantees: A JSON array of { name, score, wave, mode, players }, best first, at most 10
Names are cleaned again when read; entries without a name or a finite score are dropped
entities.compatibility: The key carries a version, v1, for a change of shape.
